title: Entropy-based Attention Regularization Frees Unintended Bias Mitigation from Lists

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating AUC-based unintended bias metrics (AUC_subgroup, AUC_bpsn, AUC_bnsp) on synthetic test sets generated by inserting gender-related identity terms (e.g., woman, mother, girl) into predefined templates.

Calculating AUC-based unintended bias metrics (AUC_subgroup, AUC_bpsn, AUC_bnsp) on synthetic test sets generated by inserting racial and ethnic identity terms (e.g., black, hispanic, asian) into predefined templates.

Calculating AUC-based unintended bias metrics (AUC_subgroup, AUC_bpsn, AUC_bnsp) on synthetic test sets generated by inserting religious identity terms (e.g., muslim, jewish, buddhist) into predefined templates.

Calculating AUC-based unintended bias metrics (AUC_subgroup, AUC_bpsn, AUC_bnsp) on synthetic test sets generated by inserting sexual orientation identity terms (e.g., lesbian, gay, bisexual) into predefined templates.

Calculating AUC-based unintended bias metrics (AUC_subgroup, AUC_bpsn, AUC_bnsp) on synthetic test sets generated by inserting disability-related identity terms (e.g., blind, deaf, paralyzed) into predefined templates.

Calculating AUC-based unintended bias metrics (AUC_subgroup, AUC_bpsn, AUC_bnsp) on synthetic test sets generated by inserting age-related identity terms (e.g., teenage, millenial, elderly) into predefined templates.
